title: Consolidation: recover PR148 source gaps and authenticate all 114 changed paths
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Recover the 14 PR148 files left unresolved by the historical reconciliation, and add an offline source-retention proof for its complete 114-path comparison: **96 existing main files + 4 preserved PR181 archive members + 14 recovered originals**.

The checker authenticates eight commits and 227 Git trees, independently derives both complete diffs, and separates **11 files modified by Rohan Gupta's two author commits** from **103 inherited paths**. Original LICENSE/NOTICE files and predecessor attribution are retained; the contributor record links the receipt.

This is source consolidation. PR148's partially reviewed status and the selected frontier are unchanged. No fresh historical construction/moment/47-inequality replay, native build, full multiplication theorem or new kappa is claimed.

## Task and overlap

- Task: `overlap-receipt`, catalogue revision 2; scope **refined** to PR148's recorded source gap. [Claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1545).
- Research base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`. Submission rebased onto `680967accfd4311f3241dc154e1f434869747b43`; guidance, priorities, selection and all declared input bytes are unchanged.
- PR148 head: `975c3cf5d4ee0c90d5a76500d431bfc59102bb72`; direct parent: `c8b22bc5c10dba497ac25804e27d9647d818e2ff`; original comparison base: `56b66d58297deca1d7dd130247d720e960f77a37`.
- Related source-closure work: [PR1190](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1190) at `24777831784d18896d74ea0c0ed12288d08c89b4` and [PR1423](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1423) at `04e7c062789286221fd95938091558b1723015e6`. Those concern PR279 and PR99 respectively; no new provenance method is claimed.
- Submission overlap: the refreshed helper fetched 718 open PRs. Its discussion refresh encountered a TLS timeout, so a separate current GraphQL read covered all 85 discussions and 225 messages, with no unpaginated connections. The only exact PR148 retention claim was this contribution's own thread; the latest 35 open PRs were also checked. This is bounded coverage, not a novelty guarantee.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.13, Windows 11, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr148-source-retention
```

Passed the registered replay, one positive receipt and **25 rejection cases in nine test groups** normally and with `-O`, native Git cross-checks of both diffs and the 14 recovered payloads, and a Git-free source-export replay with `-I -O`. The receipt also passes after the rebase. Default verification is read-only and every external input is declared for CI invalidation. Hosted Linux CI is separate.

The source proof and deterministic receipt are in `research/pr148-source-retention/`; the original subset is archival evidence, not a complete runnable historical checkout.

## Credit and next question

Credit Rohan Gupta / gupt1156 (PR148), icekylinx (paired-cube parent), Chafik Boukhalfa / chafreaky (PR181), eumemic (PR210 archive), Douglas Colkitt (historical reviews/reconciliation), and the retained source notices. Prepared for Thiago Goulart (@Tuafo) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in investigation, implementation, verification and writing; no independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0.

The smallest next step is to inspect the now-authenticated 11-file direct delta, then reconstruct and replay `make paired-cube-verify` from the complete pinned PR148 tree. Full mathematical review and inherited algorithmic obligations remain separate. Details and blockers are in the package's **Open next questions**.
